status: Markers implemented. Reload Foley intentionally absent pending approved recordings.
clock: Authoritative player reload state; never wall timers or a second animation clock.

events.physicalAction: Cross-bolt fully disengaged; hand on unlock lever.
events.audioRecommendation: Short loaded metal detent; no electrical or gunshot layer.

events.physicalAction: Captive slide reaches its rear stop with chamber exposed.
events.audioRecommendation: Heavy guided slide ending in a restrained stop contact.

events.physicalAction: Extractor releases the small spent conductive carrier.
events.audioRecommendation: Small metal release/tick; optional brief carrier rattle, not a projectile report.

events.physicalAction: One fresh kinetic slug reaches the V-block; ammunition transfers here.
events.audioRecommendation: Dense short metal seating contact; no battery insertion sound.

events.physicalAction: Slider reaches the closed receiver seat after hand contact.
events.audioRecommendation: Weighted short guided metal closure, separate from final lock.

events.physicalAction: Cross-bolt is fully engaged and cover secured.
events.audioRecommendation: Precise mechanical locking detent; no extra closing slam.

listener.signature: (event: RailgunEvent, speed: number, late: number) => void
listener.speed: Duration multiplier (e.g. 0.75 means 25% shorter). Physical event time = baselineSeconds * speed. Future Foley playback rate = 1 / speed.
listener.late: Elapsed game seconds after this physical event within the advancing frame. Future source offset = late / speed. Skip clips already exhausted at that offset.
listener.lateFrames: All crossed contacts emit in order once, including multiple events in a single frame.
listener.interruption: Cancellation discards future contacts, retains actual cover/latch/carrier/seated state. Resume plans omit completed ejection/insertion. Physical closure/lock can emit only if performed by the new plan.
listener.pause: Pause freezes the authoritative cursor; no wall timer or queued Foley.
listener.switchDeathReset: Existing switch/death/lobby cancellation removes the active sequence. New loadout/redeploy states begin clean. No audio voice or timer is allocated by these markers.
listener.readiness: Slug transfer at 1.98 s does not permit charge. Cover is closed at 2.35 s, lock finishes at 2.55 s, readiness returns at 2.80 s after recovery.
listener.legacyAudio: Railgun reload is handled silently, suppressing generic reload composites. Existing charge/fire recordings remain unchanged.
